chains.trait: Ectothermic muscle bundles with low metabolic rate
links: External heat pays the metabolic tab
Slow deliberate movements conserve energy for cognitive bursts

skill.effect: recover 20% stamina in direct sunlight over 1 turn

chains.weakness: Cold environments or night combat cause metabolic slowdown; -50% action economy

journal.en: They let the sun pay the metabolic tab so claws could build empires.

plausibility.summary: Keep ‘Thermal Soak’ to sunlit windows within F20 ±5–10 °C; tropical humidity (F8) aids night warmth retention but cloudy/wet basking still costs a turn—matches lore cold-blooded constraint without implying full inactivity all night in a tropical garden.
fixes: Keep ‘Thermal Soak’ to sunlit windows within F20 ±5–10 °C; tropical humidity (F8) aids night warmth retention but cloudy/wet basking still costs a turn—matches lore cold-blooded constraint without implying full inactivity all night in a tropical garden.

analogues.organism: Large tropical varanids and crocodilians: behaviorally thermoregulated ectothermy with cognitive bursts after warming
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

chains.trait: Vertical jaw strike for cranial mass
links: Apex hunting requires depth perception and bite force
High O2 partial pressure (F7) sustains dense muscle tissue
Vertical mandible hinge maximizes cranial leverage
Piercing attack ignores armor on first strike

skill.effect: piercing attack, ignores 30% armor, 2x damage on first turn

chains.weakness: Jaw hinge stress fractures under high-g or sudden impact; Defence required

journal.en: Their skulls are leverage engines, built to snap herbivores in half.

plausibility.summary: Theropod-like predators already use a vertical jaw hinge; emphasize enlarged temporal fossae, rostral bite point, and neck crest for inertial strike (tyrannosaurid/power- bite model), not a novel hinge axis; tie high O2 (F7) to sustained grappling, not magic armor bypass.

analogues.organism: Tyrannosaurid bite force and binocular hunting in theropods; varanid crushing bite
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

relations.note: Both rely on partial ectothermy and low metabolic rates to conserve energy in high-humidity, stable-temperature garden worlds.
Herders instinctively farm reptiles; those reptiles radiate into Saurosapients, who later subjugate and farm the Herders in a role reversal.
